consolidate_fsdp_shards: consolidate FSDP sharded checkpoint files into a single consolidated checkpoint with optional MoE expert handling
consolidate_model_parallel: consolidate model parallel shards by grouping weights per part and calling FSDP consolidate_shard_weights
reshard_megatron_parts: reshard Megatron model parts to a different number of model parallel parts or glue into one
handle_qkv_proj: split and reshard QKV projection weights and biases across model parallel parts
find_num_parts: find the number of model parallel parts from a list of checkpoint file names
